metaTitle: Custom Reflective Headbands & Wristbands | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom reflective headbands wristbands for safety events or night runs. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Reflective headbands and wristbands are essential for any event that takes place after dark, from charity night walks to evening corporate runs. The reflective material catches headlights and streetlights, keeping your team or participants visible and safe. Choose from adjustable fabric bands with silicone grip or knit styles that wick moisture. Add your logo or event name with screen printing or heat transfer for a professional finish that stands out in low light.
heroAltText: Custom reflective headbands and wristbands with printed logos for night safety events
